headline: Adopt {arm:brisk-s.low.r1}: it is the cheapest configuration that passes both accuracy and latency gates.
lede: {arm:brisk-s.low.r1} achieves {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|pct} accuracy at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.low.r1.p95} ms p95 latency and {cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1|usd_per_1k}. Tightening the accuracy threshold above {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|pct} would require switching to {arm:brisk-s.high.r1} or {arm:atlas-m.high.r1} at higher cost.

slots.text: Deploy {arm:brisk-s.low.r1}. It satisfies the {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct} pass rate gate with {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|pct} while staying well under the {criteria.p95.threshold} ms p95 latency ceiling at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.low.r1.p95} ms.

{arm:atlas-m.high.r1} reaches {measure.pass_rate.atlas-m.high.r1.mean|pct} but costs {cost_per_1k.atlas-m.high.r1|usd} and breaches latency at {measure.latency_ms.atlas-m.high.r1.p95} ms; {arm:nano-xs.off.r0} costs only {cost_per_1k.nano-xs.off.r0|usd} but fails accuracy at {measure.pass_rate.nano-xs.off.r0.mean|pct}; and {arm:brisk-s.low.r0} misses the pass gate at {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r0.mean|pct}.

Watch {weakest.arm}: its {weakest.criterion} of {weakest.value|pct} clears the {weakest.threshold|pct} threshold with a narrow buffer of {weakest.margin|pts}. Production drifts in query ambiguity could slip below the gate.
Evaluate whether caching or prompt compression can lower {arm:brisk-s.high.r1} p95 latency below {criteria.p95.threshold} ms to unlock higher accuracy.

method.text: {scoreboard.brisk-s.low.r1.cases} cases tested per arm across four task strata.
A task passes if the executed tool call sequence returns the gold result or requests required clarification.
Pass rate must meet or exceed {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct}, and latency p95 must remain under {criteria.p95.threshold} ms.
Measured token usage multiplied by list prices per thousand planner calls, including retries.
Evaluations run across synthetic query planner benchmark datasets.

sections.headline: Only three configurations satisfy both accuracy and latency criteria
sections.takeaway: Configurations in the top-left quadrant meet the pass rate floor of {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct} and p95 latency ceiling of {criteria.p95.threshold} ms.

sections.headline: Retries recover multi-hop query failures across models
sections.takeaway: Pass rate across each task category comparing configurations against the {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct} overall target.

sections.headline: Malformed syntax and missing calls account for residual errors
sections.takeaway: Sample failure traces illustrating missing tool calls, wrong arguments, and malformed outputs.

explore.title: Threshold exploration
explore.recomputes: Adjusting the pass rate floor above {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|pct} eliminates {arm:brisk-s.low.r1}, leaving no viable options under {criteria.p95.threshold} ms unless the latency ceiling is relaxed above {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.high.r1.p95} ms.

durable_claims.text: Enabling a single retry lifts Brisk-S low reasoning from {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r0.mean|pct} to {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|pct}, meeting the gate while maintaining {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.low.r1.p95} ms p95 latency at {measure.cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|usd_per_1k}.
